name: glance
description: One line of the current reflection, between two rules. Pro only. The line is the product speaking, so it types itself in on arrival (the printed-line motion); the user's own words never do.

tag.description: h1 when the glance line names the page (Ask on desktop, revision 48): the question itself, set without the printed-line span, so it does not draw in.

restated.description: The user's own question restated in the glance's slot (04-ask): plain, without the typed line (their words, not the product speaking).

line.description: The one line, written by the product about the user's record; it must be true of the record on the same screen (AGENTS.md, content against content).

exposes.--aj-c-glance-motion: The line's draw-in: none where a parent shows the line still (the overview in the writing companion); the printed-line motion otherwise.

states.default: yes: as rendered, the line types in over --g-type, after the date when the page has a handwritten date
states.loading: n/a: absent until there is a reflection

a11y.labels: none; the motion is clip-path only, the text is in the DOM from the start

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css D2 (.glance, .gline) with its own copy of the printed-line keyframes.
Option tag: the h1 form desktop Ask uses (render function and fixture only; the screens already had it).
Exposes --aj-c-glance-motion; the overview's legacy context goes (the overview places its glance by role).
Option restated: the question as the user asked it, without the typed line (04-ask). Pages round 3.
